;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 North Indian Ocean cyclone season]]
**Evacuation of approximately 800,000 people is underway as  [[Cyclone Fani|Extremely Severe Cyclonic Storm Fani]] heads toward the [[India]]n state of [[Odisha]] (''formerly Orissa'') and is expected to make landfall Friday with wind speeds in excess of 200 km/h (127 mph). [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-48121606 (BBC News)]

;Health and environment
*[[2019 measles outbreak]]
**The ''[[Freewinds]]'' cruise ship is quarantined in [[Saint Lucia]] over concerns of a [[measles]] [[epidemic]] after it is reported that one of the passengers has the disease. The cruise ship is reportedly owned by the [[Church of Scientology]], a religious organization that opposes vaccinations against diseases such as measles. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/05/02/health/st-lucia-measles-cruise-ship-quarantine/index.html (CNN)]

;Law and crime
*[[Insys Therapeutics]] founder [[John Kapoor]] is found guilty of [[Racket (crime)|racketeering]] in an opioid-related bribery scheme. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-48143094 (BBC News)]
*[[Myanmar]] security forces fire into a crowd of 275 [[Rakhine people]] detained during a search for [[Arakan Army (Kachin State)|Arakan Army]] members, killing six and wounding eight. The [[Tatmadaw|military]] claim that they were forced to shoot after some of the detainees attempted to seize their weapons, despite warning shots and verbal warnings. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-rakhine/myanmar-troops-kill-six-detain-scores-in-rakhine-over-suspected-rebel-links-military-spokesman-idUSKCN1S80R2 (Reuters)]
